19	/**
20	 * Ensures a valid authenticated session exists. Internal notification/queue
21	 * primitives call this so they cannot be invoked from unauthenticated contexts.
22	 */
23	function requireAuthenticated(): void {
24	  if (!useAuthStore.getState().currentUser) {

40	export async function createNotification(input: CreateNotificationInput): Promise<void> {
41	  requireAuthenticated()
42	  await db.notifications.add({
43	    id: generateId(),
44	    ...input,
45	    isRead: false,
46	    createdAt: Date.now(),

50	/** Create the same notification for multiple users at once.
51	 *  Respects each user's inApp subscription preference — users who have opted
52	 *  out of inApp for this notification type will not receive it.
53	 */
54	export async function createNotificationForMany(
55	  userIds: string[],
56	  fields: Omit<CreateNotificationInput, 'userId'>,
57	): Promise<void> {
58	  requireAuthenticated()
59	  // Filter to users who have inApp enabled for this type (default: true)
60	  const eligible = await Promise.all(
61	    userIds.map(async (userId) => {
62	      const pref = await getSubscription(userId, fields.type)
63	      return pref.inApp ? userId : null
64	    }),
65	  )
66	  const filtered = eligible.filter((id): id is string => id !== null)
67	  if (filtered.length === 0) return
68	
69	  const now = Date.now()
70	  await db.notifications.bulkAdd(
71	    filtered.map((userId) => ({
72	      id: generateId(),
73	      userId,
74	      ...fields,
75	      isRead: false,
76	      createdAt: now,
77	    })),
78	  )
79	}

85	export async function markNotificationRead(id: string): Promise<void> {
86	  const actorUserId = useAuthStore.getState().currentUser?.id
87	  if (!actorUserId) throw new Error('Not authenticated')

89	  if (!notif) return // idempotent — already deleted

143	export function renderTemplate(
144	  template: NotificationTemplate,

146	): { subject: string; body: string } {

148	    tpl.replace(/\{\{(\w+)\}\}/g, (_, key: string) => variables[key] ?? `{{${key}}}`)

157	export interface QueueOutboundInput {
158	  channel: OutboundChannel
159	  recipientUserId: string
160	  recipientAddress: string
161	  subject?: string
162	  /** Message body. May be omitted when templateKey + templateVariables are provided. */
163	  body?: string
164	  relatedEntityType?: string
165	  relatedEntityId?: string
166	  /**
167	   * Template key to use for rendering subject/body.
168	   * When provided the template is fetched from DB, rendered with
169	   * `templateVariables`, and its output overrides any `subject`/`body` fields.
170	   */
171	  templateKey?: string
172	  /** Variable values for template rendering (required when templateKey is set). */
173	  templateVariables?: Record<string, string>
174	  /**
175	   * Optional epoch-ms delivery timestamp.
176	   * If set and in the future, the item is created with `status: 'Scheduled'`
177	   * and held until `processScheduledQueue()` releases it.
178	   */
179	  scheduledAt?: number
180	}

182	export async function queueOutboundMessage(input: QueueOutboundInput): Promise<void> {
183	  requireAuthenticated()
184	  let subject = input.subject
185	  let body = input.body ?? ''
186	
187	  // Render template when a key is provided
188	  if (input.templateKey) {
189	    const template = await db.notificationTemplates
190	      .where('key')
191	      .equals(input.templateKey)
192	      .filter((t) => t.isActive)
193	      .first()
194	    if (template) {
195	      const rendered = renderTemplate(template, input.templateVariables ?? {})
196	      subject = rendered.subject
197	      body = rendered.body
198	    }
199	  }
200	
201	  const now = Date.now()
202	  const isScheduled = input.scheduledAt !== undefined && input.scheduledAt > now
203	
204	  await db.outboundQueue.add({
205	    id: generateId(),
206	    channel: input.channel,
207	    recipientUserId: input.recipientUserId,
208	    recipientAddress: input.recipientAddress,
209	    subject,
210	    body,
211	    templateKey: input.templateKey,
212	    relatedEntityType: input.relatedEntityType,
213	    relatedEntityId: input.relatedEntityId,
214	    status: isScheduled ? 'Scheduled' : 'Queued',
215	    scheduledAt: input.scheduledAt,
216	    attemptCount: 0,
217	    queuedAt: now,
218	  })
219	}

221	export async function markOutboundSent(id: string): Promise<void> {
222	  requirePermission('manageMessages')
223	  await db.outboundQueue.update(id, { status: 'Sent', sentAt: Date.now() })
224	}

226	/**
227	 * Mark an attempt as failed.  If retries remain, schedules the next attempt
228	 * at the configured delay (1 / 5 / 15 min).  On the 3rd failure transitions
229	 * to permanent `Failed`.
230	 */
231	export async function markOutboundFailed(id: string): Promise<void> {
232	  requirePermission('manageMessages')
233	  const item = await db.outboundQueue.get(id)
234	  if (!item) return
235	  const attempts = item.attemptCount + 1
236	  const now = Date.now()
237	  // Use attempts - 1 as index; beyond the retry schedule means terminal failure
238	  if (attempts <= RETRY_DELAYS_MS.length) {
239	    const nextDelay = RETRY_DELAYS_MS[attempts - 1]
240	    await db.outboundQueue.update(id, {
241	      status: 'Retrying',
242	      attemptCount: attempts,
243	      nextRetryAt: now + nextDelay,
244	      lastFailedAt: now,
245	    })
246	  } else {
247	    await db.outboundQueue.update(id, {
248	      status: 'Failed',
249	      attemptCount: attempts,
250	      lastFailedAt: now,
251	    })
252	  }
253	}
254	
255	/** Manually re-queue a Failed or Scheduled item, resetting its attempt counter. */
256	export async function requeueOutbound(id: string): Promise<void> {
257	  requirePermission('manageMessages')
258	  await db.outboundQueue.update(id, {
259	    status: 'Queued',
260	    attemptCount: 0,
261	    scheduledAt: undefined,
262	    sentAt: undefined,
263	    nextRetryAt: undefined,
264	    lastFailedAt: undefined,
265	  })
266	}

268	/**
269	 * Retry worker — moves Retrying items whose `nextRetryAt` has passed back to
270	 * Queued so the export/manual-process flow picks them up.
271	 *
272	 * Call `startOutboundRetryTimer()` once on app boot to run this every minute.
273	 */
274	export async function processRetryQueue(): Promise<void> {
275	  const now = Date.now()
276	  await db.outboundQueue
277	    .where('status')
278	    .equals('Retrying')
279	    .filter((item) => (item.nextRetryAt ?? 0) <= now)
280	    .modify({ status: 'Queued', nextRetryAt: undefined })
281	}
282	
283	/**
284	 * Scheduled-delivery worker — promotes `Scheduled` items to `Queued` once
285	 * their `scheduledAt` timestamp has passed.
286	 * Called by the outbound retry timer every minute.
287	 */
288	export async function processScheduledQueue(): Promise<void> {
289	  const now = Date.now()
290	  await db.outboundQueue
291	    .where('status')
292	    .equals('Scheduled')
293	    .filter((item) => (item.scheduledAt ?? 0) <= now)
294	    .modify({ status: 'Queued', scheduledAt: undefined })
295	}

297	let retryTimerId: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | null = null
298	
299	/** Start the retry + scheduled-delivery workers (idempotent — only one timer runs at a time). */
300	export function startOutboundRetryTimer(): void {
301	  if (retryTimerId !== null) return
302	  retryTimerId = setInterval(() => {
303	    void processRetryQueue()
304	    void processScheduledQueue()
305	  }, 60_000)
306	}

308	/** Stop the retry worker (used in tests / cleanup). */
309	export function stopOutboundRetryTimer(): void {
310	  if (retryTimerId !== null) {
311	    clearInterval(retryTimerId)
312	    retryTimerId = null
313	  }
314	}

366	export async function setSubscription(
367	  userId: string,
368	  notificationType: string,
369	  update: SubscriptionUpdate,
370	): Promise<void> {
371	  const currentUser = useAuthStore.getState().currentUser
372	  if (!currentUser) throw new Error('Forbidden: not authenticated')
373	  if (currentUser.id !== userId && !hasPermission(currentUser.role, 'manageMessages'))
374	    throw new Error('Forbidden: you can only update your own notification preferences')
375	  const existing = await db.notificationSubscriptions
376	    .where('userId')
377	    .equals(userId)
378	    .filter((s) => s.notificationType === notificationType)
379	    .first()
380	  if (existing) {
381	    await db.notificationSubscriptions.update(existing.id, { ...update, updatedAt: Date.now() })
382	  } else {
383	    await db.notificationSubscriptions.add({
384	      id: generateId(),
385	      userId,
386	      notificationType,
387	      inApp: update.inApp ?? true,
388	      email: update.email ?? false,
389	      sms: update.sms ?? false,
390	      officialAccount: update.officialAccount ?? false,

440	 * multi-word channel names like 'OfficialAccount' → 'officialaccount' (wrong).
441	 */
442	const CHANNEL_PREF_KEY: Record<OutboundChannel, 'email' | 'sms' | 'officialAccount'> = {
443	  Email: 'email',
444	  SMS: 'sms',
445	  OfficialAccount: 'officialAccount',
446	} as const

448	/**
449	 * Notify a user and optionally enqueue an outbound message.
450	 * Both in-app delivery and each outbound channel are gated on the user's
451	 * subscription preferences for the given notification type.
452	 * Defaults (when no preference row exists): inApp=true, email=false, sms=false,
453	 * officialAccount=false.
454	 */
455	export async function notify(
456	  input: CreateNotificationInput,
457	  outbound?: {
458	    channel: OutboundChannel
459	    address: string
460	    subject?: string
461	    body: string
462	  },
463	): Promise<void> {
464	  const pref = await getSubscription(input.userId, input.type)
465	
466	  if (pref.inApp) {
467	    await createNotification(input)
468	  }
469	
470	  if (outbound) {
471	    const prefKey = CHANNEL_PREF_KEY[outbound.channel]
472	    const wantsOutbound = pref[prefKey] === true
473	    if (wantsOutbound) {
474	      await queueOutboundMessage({
475	        channel: outbound.channel,
476	        recipientUserId: input.userId,
